instruction: Mark all emails in the Drafts folder as read

rules.sql: select (select count(*) from messages where folderID = 7) = (select count(*) from messageAttributes where attributeID = 59 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 7));

metadata.explanation: Task requires marking all emails in Drafts folder (folderID=7, contains 7 emails based on query) as read. The evaluator checks if read attribute (attributeID=59, value=1) is set for messages in folder 7. Verified from database: folder 7 is Drafts with 7 emails.

llm_judge_reasons: Correct state extraction: Getter fetches the Thunderbird database file containing email metadata
Correct SQL logic: Query compares count of all emails in folder 7 with count of emails marked as read (attributeID=59, value=1) in folder 7, ensuring ALL emails are marked as read
Complete coverage: Evaluator checks the entire requirement - all 7 emails in Drafts folder must have the read attribute
Proper postconfig: Closes Thunderbird before reading database to ensure data is flushed to disk
Correct attribute identification: Uses attributeID=59 with value=1 for read status and folderID=7 for Drafts folder
